class.name: AndExpression
class.lead: A {@link RequirementExpression} representing the {@code and} of a number of requirement expressions.
class.description: A {@link RequirementExpression} representing the {@code and} of a number of requirement expressions.

method.name: getRequirementExpressions
method.lead: Return the requirement expressions that are combined by this {@code AndExpression}.
method.description: Return the requirement expressions that are combined by this {@code AndExpression}.
method.return: An unmodifiable list of requirement expressions that are combined by this {@code AndExpression}. The list contains the requirement expressions in the order they were specified when this requirement expression was created.

class.name: ContentNamespace
class.description:
Content Capability and Requirement Namespace.
This class defines the names for the attributes and directives for this namespace. All unspecified capability attributes are of type {@code String} and are used as arbitrary matching attributes for the capability. The values associated with the specified directive and attribute keys are of type {@code String}, unless otherwise indicated.
class.author: @author $Id: a93586eef2425970fcbc684ccca026480d6df00c $

field.name: CONTENT_NAMESPACE
field.lead: Namespace name for content capabilities and requirements.
field.description:
Namespace name for content capabilities and requirements.
Also, the capability attribute used to specify the unique identifier of the content. This identifier is the {@code SHA-256} hash of the content.

field.name: CAPABILITY_URL_ATTRIBUTE
field.lead: The capability attribute that contains the URL to the content.
field.description: The capability attribute that contains the URL to the content.

field.name: CAPABILITY_SIZE_ATTRIBUTE
field.lead: The capability attribute that contains the size, in bytes, of the content.
field.description: The capability attribute that contains the size, in bytes, of the content. The value of this attribute must be of type {@code Long}.

field.name: CAPABILITY_MIME_ATTRIBUTE
field.lead: The capability attribute that defines the IANA MIME Type/Format for this content.
field.description: The capability attribute that defines the IANA MIME Type/Format for this content.

class.name: ExpressionCombiner
class.lead: An {@code ExpressionCombiner} can be used to combine requirement expressions into a single complex requirement expression using the {@code and}, {@code or} and {@code not} operators.
class.description: An {@code ExpressionCombiner} can be used to combine requirement expressions into a single complex requirement expression using the {@code and}, {@code or} and {@code not} operators.

method.description: Combine two {@link RequirementExpression}s into a requirement expression using the {@code and} operator.

The second requirement expression to combine into the returned requirement expression

method.param: The first requirement expression to combine into the returned requirement expression.
The second requirement expression to combine into the returned requirement expression
Optional, additional requirement expressions to combine into the returned requirement expression.
method.return: An {@link OrExpression} representing an {@code or} of the specified requirement expressions.

method.name: getRequirement
method.lead: Return the {@link Requirement} contained in this {@code IdentityExpression}.

class.name: Repository
class.lead: A repository service that contains {@link Resource resources}.
class.description:
A repository service that contains {@link Resource resources}.
Repositories may be registered as services and may be used as by a resolve context during resolver operations.
Repositories registered as services may be filtered using standard service properties.
class.author: @author $Id: 72fb286c9843823cecf28230415f158bdffcf8a8 $

method.name: findProviders
method.lead: Find the capabilities that match the specified requirements.
method.description: Find the capabilities that match the specified requirements.
method.param: The requirements for which matching capabilities should be returned. Must not be {@code null}.
method.return: A map of matching capabilities for the specified requirements. Each specified requirement must appear as a key in the map. If there are no matching capabilities for a specified requirement, then the value in the map for the specified requirement must be an empty collection. The returned map is the property of the caller and can be modified by the caller. The returned map may be lazily populated, so calling {@code size()} may result in a long running operation.

method.name: findProviders
method.lead: Find the resources that match the specified requirement expression.
method.description: Find the resources that match the specified requirement expression.
method.param: The {@code RequirementExpression} for which matching capabilities should be returned. Must not be {@code null}.
method.return: A promise to a collection of matching {@code Resource}s. If there are no matching resources, an empty collection is returned. The returned collection is the property of the caller and can be modified by the caller. The returned collection may be lazily populated, so calling {@code size()} may result in a long running operation.

method.name: getExpressionCombiner
method.lead: Return an expression combiner.
method.description: Return an expression combiner. An expression combiner can be used to combine multiple requirement expressions into more complex requirement expressions using {@link AndExpression and}, {@link OrExpression or} and {@link NotExpression not} operators.
method.return: An {@code ExpressionCombiner}.

method.name: newRequirementBuilder
method.lead: Return a new {@code RequirementBuilder} which provides a convenient way to create a requirement.
method.description:
Return a new {@code RequirementBuilder} which provides a convenient way to create a requirement.
For example:
Requirement myReq = repository.newRequirementBuilder("org.foo.ns1").
addDirective("filter", "(org.foo.ns1=val1)").
addDirective("cardinality", "multiple").build();
method.param: The namespace for the requirement to be created.
method.return: A new requirement builder for a requirement in the specified namespace.

field.name: URL
field.lead: Service property to provide URLs related to this repository.
field.description:
Service property to provide URLs related to this repository.
The value of this property must be of type {@code String}, {@code String[]}, or {@code Collection<String>}.

class.name: RepositoryContent
class.lead: An accessor for the content of a resource.
class.description:
An accessor for the content of a resource.
All {@link Resource} objects which represent resources in a {@link Repository} must implement this interface. A user of the resource can then cast the {@link Resource} object to this type and then obtain an {@code InputStream} to the content of the resource.
class.author: @author $Id: df42d4d71ef4d91f5e88ffeda43eed1edb4d495e $

method.name: getContent
method.lead: Returns a new input stream to the content of this resource.
method.description: Returns a new input stream to the content of this resource. The content is represented on the resource through the {@code osgi.content} capability. If more than one such capability is associated with the resource, the first such capability is returned.
method.return: A new input stream for associated content.
